Subject: HalcyonBio private deploy kickoff — network inventory and HSM handoff

Hi Grace + Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to start the implementation for the private deployment into our AWS account (us-west-2). To get the ball rolling we attached our current network inventory and a first-pass topology. Primary asks up front:

- Confirm VPC peering model (managed by Halcyon or Redwood-managed VPC).
- Guidance on private endpoint IP allocation and expected route table changes.
- HSM/key management: Halcyon will host the HSM in our VPC; we need instructions for a secure key-transfer procedure and any Redwood-side KMS integrations.

Attachments: halcyon-network-inventory.csv (CSV)

Proposed next step: 30-45 min technical session with Aditya and Neha this week to review routes and security groups. Are you available Wed or Thu morning PT?

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Head of Infrastructure, Halcyon Bio

Subject: Re: HalcyonBio private deploy kickoff — network inventory and HSM handoff

Alex / Samira — great, thanks for the inventory. Monica and I reviewed the CSV and the high‑level topology looks fine. A few clarifying items before we sit down:

1) VPC peering model options (pick one):
   - Option A: Standard AWS VPC Peering (Halcyon-owned VPC <-> Redwood VPC) — simpler, no cross-account routing changes on Redwood side, but we ask for explicit route table entries and static CIDR allocations.
   - Option B: Transit Gateway (recommended for multi-VPC future growth) — more configuration up front, needs TGW attachments + route propagation.

2) IP plan for private endpoints: please confirm 10.40.0.0/24 availability we propose to reserve for Redwood private endpoints. Also confirm /28 allocations if you need per-environment isolation.

3) HSM/key transfer: we will not import private HSM key material into Redwood-managed KMS. If Halcyon wants Redwood to call the HSM for signing, we need a mTLS mutual auth flow and short-lived cert provisioning — Aditya and Neha will outline the minimum requirements.

4) Firewall/NACL expectations: list of ports below (we'll provide official firewall rules).

Proposed times: Wed 2028-07-03 09:30 PT or Thu 2028-07-04 10:00 PT for the technical session. Please confirm.

Action items for meeting prep (we'll bring a one-page MAP):
- Halcyon: confirm VPC CIDRs, route propagation policy, and HSM vendor contact.
- Redwood (Aditya): prepare peering playbook + sample route table changes.
- Redwood (Monica): prepare onboarding checklist and DocuSign envelope for the Private Deployment Agreement.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Grace / team — Wed 9:30 PT works for us. Quick answers to your prep list:

- VPC CIDRs: primary app VPC is 10.40.0.0/16 (we can allocate 10.40.10.0/24 for Redwood endpoints as suggested).
- Route policy: Halcyon will accept propagated routes from peering; we will not allow transitive routing to other vendor VPCs.
- HSM vendor: Thales CloudHSM (cluster in our account). Our security lead (procurement email copied) will handle the formalities for HSM key export/transfer if needed.

Attaching a first draft of the network diagram; it shows the proposed /24 for endpoints and the TGW we plan to deploy.

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Jul 2028 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HalcyonBio private deploy kickoff — network inventory and HSM handoff

Thanks for the details, Samira. A few technical notes I'll cover in the session and a short checklist so we can be efficient:

Checklist (pre-meeting confirmations ideal):
- Confirm whether you'll use TGW (transit gateway) or single VPC peering. If TGW, share TGW attachment id + account numbers.
- Confirm whether private endpoints will be registered in Halcyon DNS or Redwood-provided split-horizon DNS. If split-horizon, we'll need DNS server IPs for conditional forwarding.
- HSM access model: since you host Thales CloudHSM in your account, we will request a mutually-agreed CA-signed client cert for mTLS and a small NAT/route for traffic to the HSM cluster. We cannot accept exported root keys into Redwood KMS.
- MTU: recommend 8901 for inter-VPC tunnels; confirm if there's customer-managed VPN appliances.
- BGP: if you want dynamic route exchange, we'll exchange ASN and set BGP timers.

Sample action owner assignments (draft):
- VPC peer/TGW configuration: Halcyon (Alex) — provide attachment ids and route tables by 2028-07-06.
- Private endpoints CIDR reservation: Halcyon (Samira) — confirm 10.40.10.0/24 by 2028-07-05.
- HSM mTLS cert exchange: Halcyon procurement/security — provide CA cert + contact by 2028-07-08.
- Redwood peering playbook and firewall rules: Aditya (deliverable) by 2028-07-06.

I'll bring a short runbook and a sample iptables/security-group diff to the meeting. If you prefer, we can enable a temporary support window for the actual key handshake (1-2 hours) after the config is staged.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: HalcyonBio private deploy — Mutual Action Plan and next steps

Team — thanks for the productive session yesterday. Summary + agreed next steps below (this is the working MAP; I will push a PDF and DocuSign envelope after you confirm dates):

Agreed scope: VPC peering with TGW attachment (Halcyon-managed TGW), private endpoints (10.40.10.0/24 reserved), Thales CloudHSM in Halcyon account with mTLS client cert exchange for operational signing calls. No key material will be exported to Redwood.

Mutual Action Plan (owners + target dates):
- Halcyon: Confirm TGW attachment id and account numbers, and provide final network diagram (owner: Alex) — target 2028-07-06.
- Halcyon Security/Procurement: Share CA cert and point of contact for HSM cert exchange (owner: procurement@halcyonbio.com) — target 2028-07-08.
- Redwood (Aditya): Deliver peering playbook (route table changes, SG/NACL templates, MTU/BGP guidance) — target 2028-07-06.
- Redwood (Monica): Send Private Deployment Agreement + Security Annex (DocuSign) — target 2028-07-07.
- Both: Schedule the HSM key handshake support window (1–2 hour operational window) — target week of 2028-07-09.

Deliverables attached: MAP-Halcyon-Private-Deploy-v1.pdf
DocuSign: envelope prepared and will be sent by Monica when you confirm the PO and security annex review.
HubSpot: I linked the MAP to deal HL-BIO-9921 (see link).

If there are no blockers we will target initial acceptance testing (connectivity + handshake) the week of 2028-07-16. Please reply-all with any scheduling conflicts.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you to internal staging.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
